purpose: Phase-7A hypoxia states + the PASSIVE modifiers hypoxia applies: penetration, drug-effectiveness, cell-stress susceptibility, and prediction confidence. Hypoxia does NOT directly activate signalling pathways in Phase 7A (that belongs to later phases). Schematic ordinal severity (0-1); no absolute oxygen concentration.
note: Hypoxia is a passive modifier only; it does not activate HIF-1a / signalling in Phase 7A.
